title: Dou Veer Menday Vich Maktal Day
body:
Dou Veer Menday Vich Maktal Day Pahlay Kahray Veer Don Awan
Shabbir Dasa Abbas Dasa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Guzri Howi Shaam-e-Ghareeban Da (x2) Main Kahra Haal Sunawan,
Shabbir Dasa Abbas Dasa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zara Dekh Tay Sahi Kahray Rang Day Vich Aaye Khari Haye Pak Batool Taindi (x2)
Kahray Qatil Ton Hun Mangiyan Hin (x2)
Main Saar Diyan Pak Ridawaan
Shabbir Dasa Abbas Dasa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Naraz Theway Na Behan Utay Ik Chadar Haye Oha Lah Gaye Ay (x2)
Main Lutti Howi Shaam-e-ghareeban Di (x2)
Kahray Veer Ku Kafan Pawawan
Shabbir Dasa Abbas Dasa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dastoor Hay Ja Maqtoolan Ku Koyi Wal Wal Qatal Karainda Nahi (x2)
Ei Nagri Vich Kahray Adal Kon (x2)
Tendi Zakhmi Ungal Dikhawan
Shabbir Dasa Abbas Dasa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Koyi Hukam Ta Behan Ko Day Nasar Kehray Rah Wanjna Abbas Bhira (x2)
Khara Puchda Ay Poor Yateeman Da (x2)
Menday Kolon Najaf Dyan Rahwan
Shabbir Dasa Abbas Dasa.
